newsitem.title: USA: Brooks Fiber closes Phoenix Fiberlink buy.
newsitem.headline: Brooks Fiber closes Phoenix Fiberlink buy.

text.p: Brooks Fiber Properties Inc said Monday it completed its previously announced acquisition of Phoenix Fiberlink in a deal involving an undisclosed amount of cash and 600,000 Brooks Fiber common shares.
The purchase gives Brooks Fiber local telecommunications operations in the Salt Lake City, Utah, and Reno, Nevada, markets, the company said.
Brooks Fiber provides local telecommunications services, with networks either operational or under construction in 37 U.S. cities.
Its shares were unchanged Monday at 17-7/8.
